text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A gift arrived for Shinko Windy from a 
fan.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wah-hah-hah-hah! That fan's got quite the 
commendable attitude!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that is quite a large box. Just 
what could be inside...?"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Well, once we open it, we'll know!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Boiiing!!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Gyaaah!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
A j-j-jack-in-the-box, you say...!? How 
dare you try to scare the great 
Windy-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ugahh!! What a cheeky brat you are~!
choice_data_list: ...There was a letter inside the box, too.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ngh, what? I didn't notice! Hand it over!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"I read a magazine interview and found out 
that Windy-chan loves playing pranks."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"So, we thought of a surprise present just 
for Windy-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Sorry to startle you! Feel free to use 
this as inspiration for your pranks! From 
a fan of Windy-chan"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ugah! Windy-chan is the one who does the 
scaring! Not the one who gets scared~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Mggggh...! But man, that was a pretty good 
prank...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...This guy must've really put a lot of 
thought into this for Windy-chan's sake...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
—Hmph! I shall grant thee special 
forgiveness!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And now I know they fall for it super 
easily if you pretend to be a fan giving 
them a present!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"I suppose I'll keep this jack-in-the-box 
and fan letter as a souvenir for now!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Nishishi. As expected of a fan of 
Windy-chan, this guy's got good taste!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though it caught her by surprise, Shinko 
Windy seemed quite thrilled with the fan's 
gift.
